summary: Completed comprehensive e2e testing of CAP Encampment Logistics Module. All 20 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI tests confirm all 10 tabs load, CRUD operations work for all sub-modules. Fixed a UI bug in Call Signs modal (Select.Item empty value crash).

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing includes inventory items, lost & found items, radio checkouts, comms log entries, call signs, vehicle assignments, vehicle log entries, facilities, and supply requests. All prefixed with 'TEST_' for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logistics Module is fully functional with all 10 sub-pages working: Dashboard, Inventory, Lost & Found, Radios, Comms Log, Call Signs, Vehicles, Vehicle Log, Facilities, Supply Requests. All CRUD operations work. Role-based access enforced (commander, executive_staff, logistics roles can create/edit/delete). Fixed bug: Call Sign modal Staff Category select had empty value causing crash - changed to 'none' placeholder.
